# finalproject

Final project for HSPH BST260 (Introduction to Data Science), Fall 2026,
by Yizhe Dai.

This R package and its pkgdown site present analyses of two public
health datasets.

**NHANES**: leisure-time physical activity and systolic blood pressure
among US adults aged 40 and over.

**RAND State Firearm Law Database and CDC firearm mortality**:
restrictiveness of state firearm legislation and state firearm death
rates.

See the
[proposal](https://chrisyzd.github.io/finalproject/articles/proposal.html)
for the research questions and analysis plan.

## Installation

\
`devtools``::``install_github``(``"ChrisyzD/finalproject"``)`\
[`data`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/data.html)`(``"waterborne"``, package ``=`` ``"finalproject"``)`

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cdcfiremort`](https://chrisyzd.github.io/finalproject/reference/cdcfiremort.md)
  : data from CDC on rates of mortality by firearm by state by year
- [`cdcmurd`](https://chrisyzd.github.io/finalproject/reference/cdcmurd.md)
  : data from CDC on homicide rates by state by year
- [`gunleg`](https://chrisyzd.github.io/finalproject/reference/gunleg.md)
  : data from RAND corporation on historical record of state
  legislatures actions on firearms control
- [`waterborne`](https://chrisyzd.github.io/finalproject/reference/waterborne.md)
  : data from CDC on waterborne and foodborne illness events
